source_regions.role: target Gibbs energy and phase density
strict event simplex and actual A7 prescribed density
weight matching and sector substitution; later normalized averaging excluded

route: For fixed n,T obtain the uniform rho97 with exact reversal coordinates and actual phase-first Theta measure preservation from public97 under the six original hypotheses.
Obtain rho101 and identify it with rho97 using their shared coordinate equation, function extensionality and Subtype.ext. This fixes one rho before y,r,F.
Public101 ENNReal identity gives W(q)=W(Theta(q)) pointwise for the literal actual density q times terminal live survival and the actual Gamma endpoint.
Public93 joint density measurability restricted along ((y,r),z,t) gives measurable actual rho on phase times Prefix; no parameterwise-only substitution is sufficient.

ContDiff V implies continuous V, so the literal target U and exp(-U) are continuous in phase; ENNReal.ofReal and multiplication give Measurable W. Multiplication with the user-given measurable F gives Measurable (W*F).
Apply the existing MeasurePreserving.lintegral_comp to Theta and g(q)=W(q)*F(q), for the exact ell.prod(comap Subtype.val volume). It requires no finite mass or finite integral.

Rewrite W(Theta(q)) as W(q) pointwise in the left integrand and finish by lintegral congruence. No cancellation, division, integral subtraction, normalization, Jacobian or path equality at jumps is needed.
hidden_regularity_contracts: Actual rho must be jointly measurable in initial state and strict event tuple: exact public93 second projection supplies this.
U measurability is derived internally from hV; neither measurable W nor arbitrary invariant density may be public provider hypotheses.
Theta uses the actual terminal Gamma and the same rho witness as weighted identity, with phase first in the product measure.
The test F is arbitrary measurable ENNReal on phase times Prefix. Infinity and zero multiplication use ordinary ENNReal semantics; no boundedness/integrability premise.
Sigma finiteness needed to prove the public97 product-volume result is already discharged inside that producer; lintegral_comp adds none.

degenerate_cases.n0: Unique empty tuple; no event factors, m is the zero-dimensional simplex volume. Existing parents cover this without a positive-event-count premise.
degenerate_cases.T0: For n>0 strict Prefix is empty; for n=0 the endpoint is z and Theta flips momentum, preserving the Gibbs weight.
degenerate_cases.rank0: FiniteDimensional includes the trivial space; volume and all parent results cover it.
degenerate_cases.zero_normals_rates: Literal reflection and rate definitions remain total; product may vanish and no cancellation is used.
degenerate_cases.infinity: F and either lintegral may equal top; lintegral change of variables handles this directly, including 0*top=0.

source_boundary: One unnormalized fixed-n weighted-sector substitution on phase/event space. It is the nonnegative measurable completion of the source bounded-function change-of-variables mechanism, not normalized stationary averaging, count-sum exchange, signed detailed balance, L2 or whole-paper invariance.
counterexample_search: No counterexample under stated assumptions: common-witness alignment and joint W measurability are essential internal bridges. Omitting either as an obligation would invalidate the proposed proof route, not justify a new public assumption.
